tools.name: query_scene
tools.description: Read governed WORLD GRID scene context and source-backed spatial observations.

tools.name: focus_entity
tools.description: Change presentation focus to a non-person spatial entity.

tools.name: set_quantization
tools.description: Change WORLD GRID intelligence resolution from Q0 ORBIT through Q5 OBJECT.

tools.name: serialize_scene
tools.description: Create a portable scene capsule containing view state and evidence references.

tools.name: request_action_from_evidence
tools.description: Send spatial evidence back to ATG for plan compilation. This tool never executes the requested action.
